title: Compatibility CopyEffects::set_color takes integer rect but copy shader requires normalized rect
body:
### Tested versions

Tested on master. It's not new.

### System information

Any

### Issue description

I ran into this while testing a debug draw for the compatibility renderer.

I tried to set a portion of the viewport to a color, but it covered the entire viewport.

GLES3::CopyEffects' set_color uses 
```
		copy.shader.version_set_uniform(CopyShaderGLES3::COPY_SECTION, p_region.position.x, p_region.position.y, p_region.size.x, p_region.size.y, copy.shader_version, CopyShaderGLES3::MODE_SIMPLE_COLOR);
```
and the gles copy shader expects a normalized rect:
```
#if defined(USE_COPY_SECTION) || defined(MODE_GAUSSIAN_BLUR)
// Defined in 0-1 coords.
uniform highp vec4 copy_section;
```


### Steps to reproduce

You need to change code to see bug. See MRP notes.



### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

Add a `copy_effects->set_color(Color(1.0, 1.0, 0.0, 0.5), Rect2i(Point2i(0, 0), Size2i(100, 100)));)` to one of the debug drawers in `RasterizerSceneGLES3::_render_buffers_debug_draw` and then enable in the editor.
 
It'll cover entire viewport and if Point2i is non-zero it won't draw anything.
